name: Desk Check
about: A macOS menu bar app that reads where your eyes are through the webcam and says, in centimetres, how to move your screen and desk.

groups.name: The app
groups.why: Runs in the menu bar on the person's Mac

groups.name: Build and release
groups.why: Turns the code into an app installed with Homebrew

groups.name: Checks
groups.why: Run by developers and by brew test, never shipped in the app

parts.name: app
parts.about: The menu bar popover, Live, Settings and the camera sessions behind them

parts.name: core
parts.about: Eye geometry, advice, Live bands, setups, presets and the TOML settings file, with no camera or UI

parts.name: app resources
parts.about: The app's Info.plist and its App Sandbox entitlements

parts.name: build scripts
parts.about: Builds and signs DeskCheck.app, the desk-check command, the next-version rule and a local formula test

parts.name: Homebrew formula
parts.about: Builds the app on the person's Mac during brew install

parts.name: release workflow
parts.about: Publishes a release for each merge to main that holds a feat, fix or breaking commit

parts.name: tests
parts.about: Core unit tests, offscreen view pictures, a sandbox probe and checks of the built app and command

outside.name: camera
outside.about: The Mac's cameras through AVFoundation, with Vision finding the face and eyes

outside.name: settings file
outside.about: config.toml in ~/.config/desk-check, and the old ~/.config/desk-undo folder read once to migrate

outside.name: macOS preferences
outside.about: Keeps the bookmark that lets the sandboxed app reopen a chosen settings file

outside.name: GitHub releases
outside.about: The project's tagged releases where it lives on GitHub

outside.name: Homebrew tap
outside.about: The separate tap project whose formula brew install reads
